describe: Curated sources for one event, collected by hand on 2026-11-22. Figures are quoted from the two press releases, which state a date and no time of day. A recorded gap has no date, so it must describe something that was already true at every decision time the packet is replayed at. The packet supplies evidence only: which candidates it bears on is decided by the generator.

event_time.source: SEC EDGAR acceptance of Form 6-K 0001046179-26-000796. The filing time bounds the release from above; it is not the first release time.

evidence.summary: Consolidated revenue for September 2026 was approximately NT$511.86 billion, a decrease of 0.6 percent from August 2026 and an increase of 54.6 percent from September 2025. A reading of the observable; it takes no side on any lead.

citation.locator: Body of the press release, first paragraph

evidence.summary: Consolidated revenue for October 2026 was approximately NT$586.89 billion, an increase of 14.7 percent from September 2026 and an increase of 59.7 percent from October 2025. A reading of the observable; it takes no side on any lead.

citation.locator: Body of the press release, first paragraph

evidence.summary: Total revenue up 59.7 percent from October 2025 is consistent with strong wafer demand, but a company total cannot show which designers' orders produced it or whether their guidance led it.

citation.locator: Body of the press release, first paragraph

evidence.summary: TSMC's monthly revenue releases give one consolidated total. They have no split by customer, platform or technology node; this was already so in the September 2026 release and earlier ones.
evidence.missing: Monthly revenue or wafer orders by customer or by platform, dated no later than the monthly release.
